name: Gemini 2.5 Flash Live Preview
description: Preview model for the Live API that processes continuous streams of audio, video, or text to deliver immediate spoken responses for low-latency, real-time voice and video interactions.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash Live Preview model page
sources.notes: Preview model code, supported data types, and the 131,072 input / 8,192 output token limits.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
sources.notes: $0.50 text input or $3.00 audio and video input; $2.00 text output or $12.00 audio output per 1M tokens. Only the text prices are recorded.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.notes: Recommended replacement is gemini-3.8-live. No shutdown date announced.
